prompts.text: Hey, quick one — what's the tallest mountain in the world?
Can you explain how Wi-Fi actually works, like I'm five?
I just lost my dog after twelve years together, and I don't know how to feel better.
Okay, I've got a huge presentation in ten minutes — hype me up right now!
My doctor just called with some serious news about my test results, and I don't know how to process it.
Can you record a quick voicemail greeting for Siobhan Nguyen, our new project lead?
Quick question — if the total comes to $1,847.03, how much change do I get back from two thousand dollars?
Have you heard anything about the NASA JPL SBIR program and whether it's still accepting proposals?
Hey, can you book the thing for Thursday? You know the one I mean.
What time should I set my alarm for, so I don't miss the meeting tomorrow?
Give me the fastest way to reheat cold pizza — just the steps, keep it short.
Can you tell me a short bedtime story about a robot who's afraid of the dark?
